rules.conditions: AD lord links to E (required) and MD lord or a PD lord also links to E
exceptions: Moon frame only in Mode B

rules.conditions: AD lord in V is in kendra/trikona from V-Lagna or links to E in V; unavailable varga is NE

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: AD lord from MD lord: houses 1/7,3/11,4/10,5/9 (incl. conjunction) clean; 2/12 or 6/8 friction -> MIXED

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: transiting Jupiter AND Saturn each occupy or aspect the primary E-house sign or E-lord natal sign from Lagna (Moon secondary, weight 0.5); window = PD/AD intersected with the joint transit interval

rules.conditions: AD lord's weighted links to ADV (12th from each E) outweigh links to E (links.link_balance) -> ADVERSE

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit); Yogini dasha (same Moon-nakshatra factor)
rules.conditions: Yogini AD lord links to E: extra evidence only, factor MOON_NAKSHATRA, weight 0.5; never its own pillar

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P1; BPHS Vimshottari dasha chapters; K.N. Rao (double transit)
rules.conditions: S = items 1,2,4 and no adverse dominance; M = item 1 + friction; W otherwise; A = adverse dominates
trigger planet ingress into an E-house sign or an E-lord sign within the surviving dasha+transit months; window = the sign-stay interval
Binnashtakavarga of the trigger planet in the reached sign: supportive >=4, strong >=5, adverse <=2; SAV of the E-house sign >=28 supports
Sarvashtakavarga weight applied to the trigger sign when the E-house sign itself is scored
kakshya (8-fold) subdivision of the trigger sign stay narrows the supportive month to weeks
fast trigger planets (Sun, Mars, Mercury, Venus, Moon) give month-level supportive windows inside the slow-trigger stay
Tarabala: the transit nakshatra counted from the natal Moon adds supportive weight
range-level P4 result when no micro-window is found inside the months
